heroDesc: Part developer, part strategist: I turn useful ideas into working products and the business systems around them.
storyHeadline:
I learned strategy.
Then learned to ship it.
bio:
I'm Ahmad Farooq, a Full-Stack Builder & Strategist working across React, Supabase, AI-assisted tools, and the commercial thinking that makes a product useful.

My background is in agency strategy: shaping offers, building funnels, clarifying positioning, and finding the shortest path from attention to action. That taught me how businesses sell. Building software taught me how to turn that thinking into something people can actually use.

Now I work across both sides. I can scope the product, map the user journey, build the interface and database, and connect it to the offer, sales flow, and onboarding experience. ARKA went from idea to a working SaaS dashboard in under 24 hours. Other builds span bilingual charity experiences, agency funnel systems, and conversion-focused service websites.

I use AI as leverage, not as a substitute for judgment. The goal is simple: think clearly, build quickly, and ship work that solves the right problem.

principles.title: Ship the Useful Version
principles.body: Start with the smallest complete solution to the real problem. A working product creates better feedback than a perfect plan.

principles.title: Strategy Meets the Build
principles.body: Product decisions and business decisions belong in the same room. The interface, offer, funnel, and onboarding should reinforce each other.

principles.title: Tools Serve the Outcome
principles.body: React, Supabase, Vercel, and AI are means, not the pitch. The right stack is the one that gets a reliable product into users' hands.

principles.title: Build Connected Systems
principles.body: A product does not live alone. Content, sales, data, operations, and delivery work better when they share one clear system.

principles.title: Specificity Converts
principles.body: Clear users, clear problems, and clear outcomes make both software and offers stronger. Vagueness is expensive.

principles.title: AI With Judgment
principles.body: AI speeds up research, iteration, and production. Taste, context, and responsibility still belong to the builder.

ctaHeadline:
Let's build something
people can use.
ctaSubtext: Bring the idea, bottleneck, or half-built system. We'll find the clearest path forward.
